properties.name: Recorded audio 1
properties.note: Auto-dictation of two presumed airbursts can be seen on a terminal in the Dunwich building. ** This one was likely extremely close by, as the sound of the bomb physically falling through the air before it detonated was captured. It explains why the road leading to the Dunwich building is completely gone. **

properties.name: Recorded audio 2
properties.note: Auto-dictation of two presumed airbursts can be seen on a terminal in the Dunwich Building. ** This one was likely farther away, as there appears to be the distinct sound of a shockwave following the detonation. **

properties.name: Recorded airburst audio
properties.note: Heard on a tape within abandoned mine site Kittery. Likely an airburst.
